title: Depletion duration change exploitation (centralization risk)
description: The admin can change the depletion duration parameter at any time, which affects how rewards are distributed over time. A malicious or compromised admin could exploit this to front-run their own transactions or manipulate reward rates to benefit specific addresses. This represents a centralization risk.
impact: Centralization risk where admin has significant control over reward distribution timing. Users must trust the admin not to abuse this capability.
attackPath: Admin front-runs with depletion duration change
Change affects reward calculations for pending transactions
Admin or affiliated addresses benefit from the manipulation
recommendation: Implement a timelock on depletion duration changes to give users time to react. Consider adding governance controls or multi-sig requirements for parameter changes.
